note: Imported in Overhaul slice 1 (data only). No game system reads this file yet.

entries.name: First Partner
entries.condition: Starter, or the first Pokémon to join the party
phrasings: {name} was the first to walk beside you.
Your journey began with {name} at your side.
Before there was a team, there was {name}.

entries.name: Ride or Die
entries.condition: In the party from the first node to the final node of the run
phrasings: {name} never left your side, not once, from start to finish.
From the first step to the last battle, {name} was there.
Every node of the road had {name} on it.

entries.name: First Victory
entries.condition: First battle won while active
phrasings: {name} won the first battle you ever shared.
{name} tasted victory for the first time and wanted more.
The first win belonged to {name}.

entries.name: First Catch
entries.condition: Landed the damage or status that led to the run's first successful capture
phrasings: {name} helped you catch your very first Pokémon.
Your first catch happened because of {name}.
{name} softened up your first catch just right.

entries.name: Badge Earner
entries.condition: Lands the final blow on a Gym Leader
phrasings: {name} delivered the blow that earned you a badge.
The Gym Leader fell to {name}.
{name} finished the Gym Leader off and the badge was yours.

entries.name: Boss Breaker
entries.condition: KOs a boss's ace
phrasings: {name} brought down a boss's ace.
The strongest of the boss's team fell to {name}.
{name} took out the boss's ace and broke the fight open.

entries.name: Rival's Match
entries.condition: KOs the rival's ace
phrasings: {name} beat your rival's ace.
Your rival's pride and joy went down to {name}.
{name} proved it could stand up to your rival's best.

entries.name: Hanging by a Thread
entries.condition: Wins a battle while at 5% HP or lower
phrasings: {name} won while barely standing.
{name} finished the fight with almost nothing left.
It should have fainted. {name} didn't.

entries.name: Last One Standing
entries.condition: Wins a battle as the only conscious party member
phrasings: {name} was the last one standing, and it was enough.
With every teammate down, {name} turned it around.
{name} carried the whole team's hopes alone and won.

entries.name: Grew Up Mid-Fight
entries.condition: Evolves immediately after a boss or rival battle
phrasings: {name} evolved right after the biggest fight of the day.
The battle changed {name}. It evolved afterward.
{name} came out of that fight a different Pokémon.

entries.name: Never Fainted
entries.condition: Completes 3 or more boss battles without fainting
phrasings: {name} has never fainted in a boss fight.
Three bosses and still {name} stands.
{name} walks out of every boss battle on its own feet.

entries.name: Clean Sweep
entries.condition: KOs 3 or more opponents in a single battle
phrasings: {name} swept through the opposing team.
Three down in one fight. {name} was unstoppable.
{name} left nothing standing.

entries.name: Giant Slayer
entries.condition: KOs an opponent 10 or more levels higher
phrasings: {name} took down something much stronger.
{name} was far outleveled and won anyway.
The level gap didn't matter to {name}.

entries.name: Faced a Legend
entries.condition: Participates in a Legendary encounter
phrasings: {name} stood before a Legendary Pokémon.
{name} was there when the legend appeared.
{name} will never forget the day it faced a legend.

entries.name: First Transformation
entries.condition: First Mega, Tera, Dynamax or Z use in the run
phrasings: {name} transformed for the first time.
The first transformation belonged to {name}.
{name} felt the change take hold for the first time.

entries.name: Refused to Fall
entries.condition: Enters Overdrive
phrasings: {name} refused to fall, and something awoke inside it.
{name} pushed past its limit.
Something in {name} burned brighter when it mattered most.

entries.name: In the Zone
entries.condition: Enters Hyper
phrasings: {name} found the rhythm and couldn't be stopped.
Everything clicked for {name}.
{name} was completely in the zone.

entries.name: Untouched
entries.condition: Wins a battle without taking any damage
phrasings: {name} won without a scratch.
Not a single hit landed on {name}.
{name} made it look effortless.

entries.name: One and Done
entries.condition: KOs a full-HP opponent with a single hit
phrasings: {name} dropped a healthy opponent in one hit.
One hit from {name} was all it took.
{name} ended it before it began.

entries.name: Overkill
entries.condition: KOs with damage at least double the target's remaining HP
phrasings: {name} hit far harder than it needed to.
That was more than enough, {name}.
{name} left no doubt.

entries.name: Avenged
entries.condition: KOs the Pokémon that KO'd a teammate in the same battle
phrasings: {name} avenged a fallen teammate.
{name} made the foe pay for what it did to a friend.
A teammate went down, and {name} answered.

entries.name: Cleanup Duty
entries.condition: Scores the final KO of a trainer battle three times
phrasings: {name} keeps getting the last word.
{name} finishes what the others start.
Again and again, {name} takes the final KO.

entries.name: Weakness Hunter
entries.condition: Lands 3 super-effective hits in a row
phrasings: {name} found the weakness every time.
Three super-effective hits in a row for {name}.
{name} read the matchup perfectly.

entries.name: Lucky Streak
entries.condition: Lands 3 critical hits in one battle
phrasings: {name} kept landing critical hits.
The luck ran hot for {name}.
Critical hit after critical hit from {name}.

entries.name: Plague Bearer
entries.condition: Inflicts 10 status conditions in a run
phrasings: {name} has a knack for making foes miserable.
{name} wore down opponents with status after status.
Few foes escaped {name} unaffected.

entries.name: Immovable
entries.condition: Takes 5 or more hits in a single battle without fainting
phrasings: {name} took hit after hit and kept standing.
Nothing seemed to move {name}.
{name} was a wall that day.

entries.name: Safe Landing
entries.condition: Switches in and absorbs 10 attacks over a run
phrasings: {name} keeps taking the hit for the team.
{name} is the one you send in when it hurts.
{name} stepped in again and again to absorb the blow.

entries.name: First to Strike
entries.condition: Outspeeds and KOs 20 opponents
phrasings: {name} strikes before anyone can react.
{name} is always first.
The foes never got to move before {name}.

entries.name: Last Move Standing
entries.condition: KOs with the final PP of a move
phrasings: {name} won with its very last use of the move.
{name} squeezed the final PP out for the win.
One use of the move left, and {name} made it count.

entries.name: Hold On
entries.condition: Survives a lethal hit through Endure, Sturdy, Focus Sash or similar
phrasings: {name} hung on through a hit that should have ended it.
{name} refused to go down.
{name} survived by the narrowest margin.

entries.name: Quick Finish
entries.condition: KOs with a priority move while slower than the target
phrasings: {name} got there first when it shouldn't have.
{name} snuck in a finishing blow.
{name} beat the clock with a priority move.

entries.name: Storm Chaser
entries.condition: Wins a battle while its own weather is active
phrasings: {name} won under skies it made itself.
{name} used the weather to its advantage.
The weather turned for {name}.

entries.name: Comeback
entries.condition: Wins after the party was behind by two or more Pokémon
phrasings: {name} turned a lost battle around.
The battle looked lost until {name} stepped up.
{name} came back from the brink.

entries.name: Patient Wins
entries.condition: Wins a battle that lasted 15 or more turns
phrasings: {name} outlasted everyone in a long, grinding battle.
{name} played the long game and won.
It took forever, but {name} won in the end.

entries.name: Quick Work
entries.condition: Wins a trainer battle in 3 turns or fewer
phrasings: {name} ended that fight before it started.
The battle was over in a flash thanks to {name}.
{name} made quick work of it.

entries.name: Relief Pitcher
entries.condition: Switches in after a teammate faints and wins the battle
phrasings: {name} stepped in when it mattered and won.
{name} came off the bench and saved the battle.
{name} took over from a fallen teammate and finished it.

entries.name: Back on Its Feet
entries.condition: Is revived or healed from fainted status and wins the same battle
phrasings: {name} got back up and kept fighting.
Down but not out, {name} returned.
{name} came back from fainting to win.

entries.name: Boss Regular
entries.condition: Participates in 5 boss battles
phrasings: {name} has stood against five bosses.
Five bosses and counting for {name}.
{name} is a veteran of boss fights.

entries.name: Badge Collector
entries.condition: Active in every Gym battle of the run
phrasings: {name} fought in every Gym of the journey.
No Gym went by without {name}.
{name} was there for every badge.

entries.name: Elite Contender
entries.condition: Participates in an Elite Four battle
phrasings: {name} fought at the Elite Four.
The Elite Four couldn't shake {name}.
{name} made it all the way to the Elite Four.

entries.name: Champion's Challenger
entries.condition: Participates in the Champion battle
phrasings: {name} faced the Champion.
{name} stood across from the Champion.
{name} made it to the very top.

entries.name: Champion's Bane
entries.condition: KOs the Champion's ace
phrasings: {name} brought down the Champion's ace.
The Champion's best fell to {name}.
{name} defeated the Champion's strongest.

entries.name: Team Breaker
entries.condition: KOs an evil-team leader's ace
phrasings: {name} stopped the villain's best Pokémon.
The villain's ace fell to {name}.
{name} broke the evil team's strongest.

entries.name: Admin Defeated
entries.condition: Participates in defeating an evil-team admin
phrasings: {name} helped take down an admin.
An admin went down with {name}'s help.
{name} fought through the evil team's ranks.

entries.name: Grunt Crusher
entries.condition: KOs 15 evil-team grunt Pokémon
phrasings: {name} has sent a lot of grunts packing.
The grunts keep falling to {name}.
{name} is the grunts' worst nightmare.

entries.name: Shapeshifter
entries.condition: Uses transformations in 3 different battles
phrasings: {name} has transformed three times over.
{name} is getting used to changing shape.
Transformation is becoming second nature for {name}.

entries.name: Mega Resonance
entries.condition: Mega Evolves for the first time
phrasings: {name} Mega Evolved for the first time.
The bond between you and {name} reached a new level.
{name} felt the stone's power respond.

entries.name: Signature Strike
entries.condition: Uses its Mega Signature Move for the first time
phrasings: {name} unleashed its signature move.
{name} showed the world what only it can do.
{name}'s signature move landed.

entries.name: Crystal Heart
entries.condition: Terastallizes for the first time
phrasings: {name} turned to crystal for the first time.
{name}'s true type shone through.
{name} Terastallized and everything changed.

entries.name: Giant Moment
entries.condition: Dynamaxes for the first time
phrasings: {name} grew enormous for the first time.
{name} towered over the field.
{name} Dynamaxed for the first time.

entries.name: Gigantamax Glory
entries.condition: Gigantamaxes for the first time
phrasings: {name} Gigantamaxed and the whole field shook.
{name} took a form few ever see.
{name}'s Gigantamax form made its debut.

entries.name: Z-Power
entries.condition: Uses a Z-Move for the first time
phrasings: {name} released Z-Power for the first time.
{name} and you moved as one for a Z-Move.
{name}'s Z-Move lit up the arena.

entries.name: Perfect Type
entries.condition: Terastallizes to its own original type
phrasings: {name} doubled down on what it already was.
{name}'s Tera Type matched its heart.
{name} became more itself.

entries.name: Giant Stand
entries.condition: Wins a battle while Dynamaxed at under 25% HP
phrasings: {name} won while giant and hurting.
Even Dynamaxed, {name} was running on fumes.
{name} was huge, but only just holding on.

entries.name: Pure Strength
entries.condition: Wins 3 boss battles without ever transforming
phrasings: {name} needs no transformation to win.
{name} wins on raw strength alone.
No form changes, no gimmicks. Just {name}.

entries.name: Evolved
entries.condition: Evolves
phrasings: {name} evolved.
{name} grew into something new.
The journey changed {name}.

entries.name: Final Form
entries.condition: Reaches its final evolution
phrasings: {name} reached its final form.
{name} grew as far as it could grow.
There is nowhere left for {name} to evolve, and it's magnificent.

entries.name: Twice Grown
entries.condition: Evolves twice in a single run
phrasings: {name} evolved twice on this journey.
Two evolutions for {name}, and the journey isn't over.
{name} has changed twice along the way.

entries.name: Early Bloomer
entries.condition: Evolves before node 10
phrasings: {name} evolved before the journey really got going.
{name} grew up fast.
{name} was ready earlier than anyone expected.

entries.name: Late Bloomer
entries.condition: Evolves after node 40
phrasings: {name} took its time and then evolved.
{name} evolved late, and it was worth the wait.
The wait for {name}'s evolution was long.

entries.name: Stone-Touched
entries.condition: Evolves using an evolution item
phrasings: {name} evolved through the power of a stone.
The stone's glow changed {name}.
{name} evolved the moment it touched the stone.

entries.name: Trade Bond
entries.condition: Evolves through a trade
phrasings: {name} evolved after a trade.
{name} changed on the exchange.
The trade transformed {name}.

entries.name: Friendship's Reward
entries.condition: Evolves through friendship
phrasings: {name} evolved because of how much it trusts you.
{name}'s bond with you made it evolve.
{name} grew close enough to you to evolve.

entries.name: Family Gathering
entries.condition: Evolves with 3 or more teammates in the party
phrasings: {name} evolved with the whole team watching.
The team cheered when {name} evolved.
{name}'s evolution was a team celebration.

entries.name: Hidden Path
entries.condition: Evolves along a custom or hidden evolution path
phrasings: {name} took a path almost nobody knew existed.
{name} evolved in a way nobody expected.
{name} discovered a secret way to grow.

entries.name: Rare Find
entries.condition: Joins after a Rare-or-better capture
phrasings: {name} was a rare find.
You were lucky to meet {name}.
{name} is one in a thousand.

entries.name: Shining Star
entries.condition: Is a shiny Pokémon
phrasings: {name} sparkles like nothing else on your team.
A shiny {name}: you'll never forget the moment you saw it.
{name} shines in more ways than one.

entries.name: Glitter Victory
entries.condition: A shiny Pokémon wins a boss battle
phrasings: {name} sparkled all the way to victory.
{name} shone brightest when it counted.
A shiny {name} won the day.

entries.name: Legend Joined
entries.condition: Joins the party after a Legendary encounter
phrasings: {name} joined you after an extraordinary encounter.
A legend chose to walk with you: {name}.
{name} is a legend that became a companion.

entries.name: Myth Joined
entries.condition: Joins the party after a Mythical encounter
phrasings: {name} joined you after a once-in-a-lifetime meeting.
A mythical Pokémon trusts you: {name}.
{name} came from a story most people don't believe.

entries.name: Born on the Road
entries.condition: Hatched from an egg during the run
phrasings: {name} hatched during your journey.
{name} was born on the road.
{name} has never known anything but this adventure.

entries.name: Sparkling Egg
entries.condition: Hatched shiny
phrasings: {name} hatched sparkling.
The egg opened and {name} shone.
{name} hatched already shining.

entries.name: Exchange Student
entries.condition: Joined through a trade
phrasings: {name} came to you in a trade.
{name} joined the team through an exchange.
Somebody else raised {name} first.

entries.name: A Gift
entries.condition: Received as an NPC gift
phrasings: {name} was given to you as a gift.
Someone believed in you enough to give you {name}.
{name} was a gift from the road.

entries.name: Rescued
entries.condition: Joined after a rescue event
phrasings: {name} joined after you helped it in its time of need.
{name} remembers who helped it.
You saved {name}, and {name} chose to stay.

entries.name: Chain Reaction
entries.condition: Joined as the reward of a multi-stage event chain
phrasings: {name} was the end of a long chain of events.
{name} joined after a story that took many steps.
{name} was worth every step of the journey to find.

entries.name: Fast Friends
entries.condition: Reaches bond 40 with any teammate within 5 nodes of joining
phrasings: {name} made friends almost immediately.
{name} fit in right away.
The team welcomed {name} instantly.

entries.name: Best Friends
entries.condition: Reaches bond 70 with a teammate
phrasings: {name} found a best friend on the team.
{name} and a teammate became inseparable.
A true friendship formed around {name}.

entries.name: Heart of the Team
entries.condition: Reaches bond 50 or higher with every party member
phrasings: {name} is the heart of the team.
Everyone on the team is close to {name}.
{name} holds the whole team together.

entries.name: Rivals Within
entries.condition: Enters a Friendly Rivals relationship
phrasings: {name} found a worthy rival on its own team.
{name} spurs a teammate to do better.
A friendly rivalry began around {name}.

entries.name: Mentor
entries.condition: Gives a mastery boost to a younger teammate through mentorship
phrasings: {name} taught a teammate what it knows.
{name} became a mentor to a younger teammate.
A younger Pokémon is learning from {name}.

entries.name: Shoulder to Lean On
entries.condition: Is present when a teammate recovers from fainting at a rest node
phrasings: {name} stayed beside a teammate through the recovery.
{name} watched over a hurt friend.
A teammate healed with {name} nearby.

entries.name: Campfire Regular
entries.condition: Features in 5 camp scenes
phrasings: {name} is always at the campfire.
{name} loves rest nodes.
The campfire wouldn't be the same without {name}.

entries.name: Named by You
entries.condition: Was given a nickname
phrasings: {name} answers to the name you gave it.
You gave {name} its name, and it fits.
{name} wears the name you picked with pride.

entries.name: Complete Trust
entries.condition: Reaches maximum friendship
phrasings: {name} trusts you completely.
{name} would follow you anywhere.
The bond between you and {name} is unbreakable.

entries.name: Guardian
entries.condition: Takes a hit meant to KO a low-HP teammate (switch-in or Protect-style move)
phrasings: {name} took the blow meant for a friend.
{name} stood in the way of a knockout.
{name} protected a teammate when it counted.

entries.name: Fell With Honor
entries.condition: Faints in a boss battle after landing 2 or more KOs
phrasings: {name} went down fighting after taking out two foes.
{name} fell, but it took the foes with it.
{name}'s last stand won the battle's momentum.

entries.name: Close Call
entries.condition: Survives a hit leaving it with exactly 1 HP
phrasings: {name} survived with a single HP.
One HP was all {name} needed.
{name} cheated fate by one point.

entries.name: Shake It Off
entries.condition: Wins a battle after being afflicted with a status condition
phrasings: {name} won in spite of being sick.
A bad status didn't stop {name}.
{name} powered through its condition.

entries.name: Thawed Out
entries.condition: Wins a battle after being frozen
phrasings: {name} thawed out and won.
{name} was frozen solid and still came out on top.
Frozen, then fierce: {name}.

entries.name: Rested Warrior
entries.condition: Wins a battle after waking from sleep
phrasings: {name} woke up and won.
{name} slept through some of it and still won.
{name} woke at the right moment.

entries.name: Burning Spirit
entries.condition: Wins a battle after being burned
phrasings: {name} won while burning.
The burn didn't slow {name}.
{name} fought on through the flames.

entries.name: Shock Value
entries.condition: Wins a battle after being paralyzed
phrasings: {name} won in spite of paralysis.
Paralysis couldn't stop {name}.
{name} fought through the numbness.

entries.name: Poisoned and Proud
entries.condition: Wins a battle after being poisoned
phrasings: {name} won with poison coursing through it.
Poison couldn't beat {name}.
{name} endured the poison and finished the job.

entries.name: Clear Head
entries.condition: Wins a battle after being confused
phrasings: {name} shook off the confusion and won.
{name} fought through a fog.
{name} got its head together just in time.

entries.name: Weathered the Storm
entries.condition: Wins a battle in weather unfavorable to its type
phrasings: {name} won in conditions that should have beaten it.
The weather was against {name}, and it won anyway.
{name} fought the elements and won.

entries.name: Against the Odds
entries.condition: KOs an opponent that resists all of its moves through a secondary move or type change
phrasings: {name} found a way through a wall.
{name} cracked a matchup that shouldn't be winnable.
{name} found the one thing that worked.

entries.name: Dance Party
entries.condition: Sets up with a stat-boosting move and then KOs 2 or more opponents
phrasings: {name} set up and swept the field.
{name} danced, then dominated.
{name} found its moment, boosted, and ran wild.

entries.name: Sturdy Shield
entries.condition: Sets up screens that last the full duration 3 times
phrasings: {name} keeps the team protected.
{name}'s screens saved the day again.
The team is safe behind {name}'s barrier.

entries.name: Hazard Lord
entries.condition: Sets entry hazards that deal damage 10 times
phrasings: {name} laid traps that paid off.
{name}'s hazards keep punishing foes.
The foes keep tripping over what {name} left behind.

entries.name: Team Medic
entries.condition: Restores HP to teammates 10 times via moves, abilities or items
phrasings: {name} keeps the team healthy.
{name} patches everyone up.
The team leans on {name} when it hurts.

entries.name: Quiet Hero
entries.condition: Contributes the highest support score in a boss battle
phrasings: {name} won the battle without leading the damage.
{name} was the unsung hero of that fight.
Nobody noticed {name}, but nothing worked without it.

entries.name: First Blood
entries.condition: Scores the first KO of a boss battle three times
phrasings: {name} draws first blood in boss fights.
{name} always opens the scoring.
{name} gets the first KO and sets the tone.

entries.name: Rival Rival
entries.condition: Participates in 3 rival battles
phrasings: {name} has stood against your rival three times.
Three rival battles and {name} was in every one.
{name} knows your rival well by now.

entries.name: Turning the Tables
entries.condition: Beats a rival's Pokémon that KO'd a teammate in an earlier rival battle
phrasings: {name} settled the score with your rival.
{name} finally got revenge on your rival's Pokémon.
The tables turned, thanks to {name}.

entries.name: Beat the Counter
entries.condition: Defeats the Pokémon the rival brought specifically to counter you
phrasings: {name} beat the very counter your rival prepared.
Your rival's plan failed against {name}.
{name} defeated the answer to its own strength.

entries.name: Not Forgotten
entries.condition: Is named in a rival's memory callback
phrasings: Your rival remembers {name}.
{name} left a mark on your rival.
Even your rival can't forget {name}.

entries.name: Marked by Evil
entries.condition: Is named in a villain's dialogue callback
phrasings: The villain knew {name} by name.
{name} caught the evil team's attention.
The evil team keeps an eye on {name}.

entries.name: Event Hero
entries.condition: Is the deciding Pokémon in an event chain's final stage
phrasings: {name} saved the day in an event that took many steps.
{name} carried the final stage of the chain.
It all came down to {name}.

entries.name: Signature Scene
entries.condition: Is featured in its species-signature moment
phrasings: {name} had its moment.
{name} did something only {name} could do.
That was pure {name}.

entries.name: At Home Here
entries.condition: Reacts to a region-specific moment
phrasings: {name} felt right at home.
{name} loved this place.
The region spoke to {name}.

entries.name: Local Expert
entries.condition: Is in the party for all battles of a region
phrasings: {name} walked an entire region with you.
{name} saw the region from end to end.
{name} knows this region like home.

entries.name: World Traveler
entries.condition: Is in the party across 3 different regions
phrasings: {name} has traveled to three regions with you.
Three regions, one {name}.
{name} has seen more of the world than most.

entries.name: Rare Chain Finisher
entries.condition: Is in the party for a Very Rare or Unique event chain
phrasings: {name} was there for something extraordinary.
{name} lived through a rare tale.
{name} saw something almost no one sees.

entries.name: Sworn to Secrecy
entries.condition: Is in the party for a Legendary Sighting
phrasings: {name} saw a legend from afar.
{name} watched a Legendary pass by.
{name} is one of the few to have seen it.

entries.name: Trial Survivor
entries.condition: Is active during a Legendary trial battle and passes it
phrasings: {name} passed a Legendary's trial.
{name} was judged worthy.
{name} proved itself to a legend.

entries.name: Chased Away
entries.condition: Is active when a Legendary flees
phrasings: {name} was there when the legend disappeared.
The legend fled, but {name} will remember.
{name} watched the legend slip away.

entries.name: Relic Finder
entries.condition: Finds an ancient relic via a Curious or Ground-type reaction
phrasings: {name} sniffed out a relic.
{name} dug up something old.
{name} found a piece of history.

entries.name: Treasure Hunter
entries.condition: Finds 5 items through teammate-find moments
phrasings: {name} keeps digging up treasure.
{name} has a nose for finding things.
Another find from {name}!

entries.name: Berry Fiend
entries.condition: Eats 10 berries in a run
phrasings: {name} can't resist a berry.
{name}'s favorite thing is a good berry.
Berries disappear when {name} is around.

entries.name: Always on the Mend
entries.condition: Is healed 20 times across the run
phrasings: {name} spends a lot of time getting patched up.
{name} takes the hits and keeps coming back for more.
{name} has been patched up more than anyone.

entries.name: Ahead of the Curve
entries.condition: Is 5 or more levels above the party median
phrasings: {name} is far ahead of the pack.
{name} has pulled well ahead of its teammates.
Nobody on the team can catch up to {name}.

entries.name: Late Starter
entries.condition: Contributes a boss KO while 5 or more levels below the party median
phrasings: {name} is behind the rest in level and keeps up anyway.
{name} contributes beyond its level.
{name} punches above its level.

entries.name: Move Master
entries.condition: Masters a move (80 uses)
phrasings: {name} mastered a move.
Eighty uses and {name} has the move down.
{name} made the move its own.

entries.name: Triple Master
entries.condition: Masters 3 moves
phrasings: {name} has mastered three moves.
{name}'s moveset is a work of art.
Three moves mastered: {name} is a specialist.

entries.name: Centurion
entries.condition: Participates in 100 battles
